cards.title: Should you tell mother-in-law to stop buying girly clothes?
cards.body: A parenting dilemma about gender stereotypes and children's clothing choices. Advice on navigating family dynamics while respecting your parenting values.

cards.title: Ikea trip reveals parenting failures and life lessons
cards.body: A humorous take on what pre-university shopping reveals about domestic wisdom. Parents discover gaps in teaching their children practical skills.

cards.title: Suburban life with family: finding joy in unexpected places
cards.body: A family's journey from viewing suburban life as boring to discovering its hidden charm. Practical insights on building community and happiness with children.

cards.title: Guardian view: falling birthrates require more than cash
cards.body: Young people still want families but face insecurity and isolation. Governments must address systemic barriers preventing people from building families.

cards.title: Girls legally entitled to wear trousers in NI schools
cards.body: Northern Ireland schools must offer girls the option to wear trousers as part of uniform policies from 2027/28 onwards. New guidelines promote inclusivity in student dress codes.
